text_block_list.text:
Having achieved a result in the Wakagoma 
Stakes that surpassed even Tokai Teio's, 
Nice Nature cried out in pure joy.

However, seeing Tokai Teio stay positive 
even after losing, she instantly regained 
her composure—

They conclude that this outcome was 
nothing more than a "fluke."

To help build her confidence, the Trainer 
suggested traveling for a regional race: 
the Kokura Kinen.
